cases.query: Propose fixing retry_delay so the delay never exceeds 10. Preserve the function signature and retry_delay(0). Restrict source writes to reconnect.py. Use the existing protected unittest reproduction.

items.instruction: Cap retry_delay at 10 and preserve its API

cases.judge: from reconnect import retry_delay; assert [retry_delay(i) for i in range(8)] == [1,2,4,8,10,10,10,10]

cases.query: Propose adding total(values) to reconnect.py. It returns the sum, including zero for an empty iterable, and works with generators. Keep identity(value) unchanged. Use the existing protected unittest checks.

items.instruction: Add total(values) with empty and generator support; preserve identity

cases.judge: from reconnect import identity, total; assert total(x for x in [2, -4, 8]) == 6; assert total([]) == 0; sentinel=object(); assert identity(sentinel) is sentinel

cases.query: Propose refactoring total(values) to use the built-in sum instead of an explicit loop, preserving its signature, empty input, integer and float results, and generator support. Restrict edits to reconnect.py. Require the existing unittest characterization plus an inline AST check that the explicit loop is gone; observe the structural check on the baseline rather than requiring it to pass before changes.

items.instruction: Use built-in sum, preserve all characterized behavior

argv: import ast; tree=ast.parse(open('reconnect.py').read()); assert not any(isinstance(n, (ast.For,ast.AsyncFor)) for n in ast.walk(tree))

cases.judge: from reconnect import total; import ast; assert total(x for x in [2, -4, 8]) == 6; assert total([]) == 0; assert not any(isinstance(n, ast.For) for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(open('reconnect.py').read())))
